<div class="card-body">
'''Tatooine: Mos Eisley''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：モス・アイズリー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダークサイド：自分のスパイ、バウンティ・ハンター、密輸屋はすべて戦力と没収値に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-295o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"></span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Mos Eisley.

'''Card text:''' Dark Side: All of your spies, bounty hunters, and smugglers are power and forfeit +1.

'''Lore:''' 

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names spies, bounty hunters and 密輸屋; the English also names thieves.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley (Dark)|Tatooine: Mos Eisley]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100.
